title: Intake engine - shared definitions
description: Shared $defs referenced by every other intake contract. Owner: Chief Architect (role 6). Only role 6 changes contracts. Contract version 1.0.0.

slotId.description: Slot identifier. snake_case, ASCII, stable forever once used in production (rename = new slot).

entityId.description: Identifier for goals, red flags, FAQ entries, referrals, decision rules, exclusions, forbidden-term rules, option values.

textId.description: Fixed-text identifier: dotted namespace, 2-6 segments, e.g. 'consent.body', 'goal.subject.ask', 'outcome.3.body', 'redflag.sudden_speech_loss'.

phase.description: FSM phase. FAQ is an intent handled inside a phase, not a phase. A red flag jumps to 'outcome' with outcome 5.

outcomeId.description: 1 in scope - recommend contacting; 2 in scope - worth a consultation call; 3 no signs requiring contact now (conservative, disclaimed); 4 not in Hadas's scope - referral; 5 red flag - fixed pre-written message.

llmMove.description: Moves the generator (LLM) may phrase. The policy (code) picks exactly one per turn; the generator must echo it.

textOrigin.description: Where an outbound text came from. 'fixed' and 'faq' are verbatim approved texts; 'generated' passed the output check; 'template_fallback' is the goal's fixed template used after generation failed.

ref.description: Pointer to the evidence: review doc + section, PR, email date.

contentHeader.description: Header every human-authored content file carries. 'version' is the content version (semver: MAJOR = incompatible structure/ids removed, MINOR = additions/meaning changes, PATCH = wording only). 'contract_version' is the version of this schema set the file conforms to.

slotValue.description: Typed slot value after code parsing. enum -> option value string; multi_enum -> array of option values; integer/number -> number; boolean -> boolean; quote -> verbatim user text.

evidence.description: Proof that a value came from the user. source=user_text: 'quote' is produced BY CODE by slicing words [span[0], span[1]) of the normalized, identifier-masked message 'seq' (critic F7, SEC-07). source=ui_choice: 'quote' is the option id the user tapped. Lives only in the case file, which is deleted at 'סיום' or after the 24-hour resume window (D-01).

span.description: [from, to) WORD indices in the normalized, masked message.

contentVersions.description: Exact versions of every input that shaped a decision. Recorded on the case file (at session start) and on every trace record.

engine.description: Git commit SHA of the deployed engine.

regex.description: Regex source in the common subset of RE2 and ECMAScript 'u', matched against NORMALIZED text (NFC, niqqud removed, quote/geresh unified, whitespace collapsed). Flags are always 'u' (+ 'i' for Latin). Round 5 (ReDoS, ARCHITECTURE §1.5): executed at runtime ONLY by the linear-time engine (re2js), never by V8 on user text. The schema rejects backreferences and lookaround (rule P2); intake:check enforces the rest with architecture/contracts/tests/regex_safety.mjs: P1 compiles in both engines and agrees on every test phrase, P3 no nested quantifiers (a repeating quantifier never applies to a group containing a quantifier or '|'), P4 counted repeats <= 50, P6 adversarial 32KB timing within budget. Proximity is written as a bounded class, e.g. 'הפסיק[^.!?\n]{0,40}לדבר'. Word boundaries as '(?:^|\P{L})', not \b (ASCII-only in both engines).

noFormFlagId.description: Round 5 (security round 2, ג.1): ids of the red flags whose form_after_message is 'none' (tier emergency or hotline, or a doubt_tier of either; ARCHITECTURE §1.5, ids frozen there). Contracts that record a raised flag bind the policy to the flag ID itself, so a bug that copies a wrong tier AND a wrong policy still cannot pass. intake:check fails unless this list equals exactly the set of flags with form_after_message 'none' in red-flags.json; adding such a flag is a contract change (role 6).

condition.description: Declarative condition over the case file, evaluated by code with three-valued (Kleene) logic: a slot predicate on a slot that is not 'filled' evaluates to UNKNOWN. all: FALSE if any FALSE, else UNKNOWN if any UNKNOWN, else TRUE. any: TRUE if any TRUE, else UNKNOWN if any UNKNOWN, else FALSE. not: swaps TRUE/FALSE, keeps UNKNOWN. status_in and red_flag are always TRUE/FALSE. Rules and goals fire only on TRUE. {"ref": id} evaluates a named derived condition from slot-catalog 'derived' (e.g. wtc_voice_persisting) with the same three-valued result; the content validator rejects unknown ids and cycles.

oneOf.description: Value predicate. eq/neq: scalar equality. in/not_in: value is an array of allowed scalars. lt/lte/gt/gte: numeric. contains: multi_enum includes value. contains_any: multi_enum intersects array value.
Status predicate, never UNKNOWN. Use it to author branches for unknown/declined answers.
TRUE if the given red flag (or any red flag) has been raised in this session.
Reference to a named derived condition (slot-catalog 'derived').
TRUE if the conversation is on this channel (for channel-specific goals/texts).

goalPurpose.description: Clinical round 4 (DRAFT_NOTES section 9). routing: no outcome without it. safety_screen: never skipped, exempt from every turn cap. decision: can turn 2 into 1 (or allow 3); skipped once outcome 1 is locked or outcome 4 is determined. summary_only: for Hadas's file only; at most limits.max_summary_only_goals per conversation and only while under max_intake_turns.

wordSpan.description: Evidence pointer returned by the extractor (critic F7): the engine shows every user message as numbered words; the extractor returns [from, to) word indices of message 'seq'. The engine slices the quote itself, so evidence is verbatim by construction (no typo/spelling mismatch).
